show.description: Machine Aur Mohabbat is a romantic sci-fi drama about love beyond humanity. After celebrity chef Nihaal dies in an accident, scientists create an AI robot, NI-01 using his memories and likeness. Six years later, NI-01 re-enters the lives of Nihaal’s lost love, Charvi, and thier son, Neil. As he hides his true identity, the robot begins to experience human emotions - love, jealousy, pain, and attachment —raising a profound question, can a machine truly love, and can love make it human? Watch now!
